local ready=false
local loading=false
for _=1,100 do
  local title=PG:FindFirstChild('TitleBackdrop')

    end
  end
  if ready then break end
  task.wait(0.5)
end

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BoardingGui"),"CARD_BOARD_NOT_OPEN")
-- [실제 손패 터치] 화면에 보이는 첫 손패 카드를 실제 마우스로 누른다.
for i=1,30 do if g:GetAttribute("CardTurn")=="me" then break end task.wait(0.3) end
assert(g:GetAttribute("CardTurn")=="me","CARD_NOT_MY_TURN:"..tostring(g:GetAttribute("CardTurn")))
local tray=assert(g:FindFirstChild("NavalCardHandTray",true),"CARD_HAND_TRAY_MISSING")
local best
for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
 if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("HandIdx") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>20 then
  local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
  local inView=not sf or (d.AbsolutePosition.X>=sf.AbsolutePosition.X and d.AbsolutePosition.X+d.AbsoluteSize.X<=sf.AbsolutePosition.X+sf.AbsoluteSize.X)
  if inView and (not best or d.AbsolutePosition.X<best.AbsolutePosition.X) then best=d end
 end
end
assert(best,"CARD_HAND_NO_VISIBLE_CARD")
workspace:SetAttribute("QACardBoardBefore",g:GetAttribute("CardBoardMe"))
workspace:SetAttribute("QACardHandBefore",g:GetAttribute("CardHandMe"))
workspace:SetAttribute("QACardPickIdx",best:GetAttribute("HandIdx"))
return string.format("%d,%d CLICK=hand_card_%s",math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.X+best.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.Y+best.AbsoluteSize.Y/2),tostring(best:GetAttribute("HandIdx")))

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BoardingGui"),"CARD_BOARD_NOT_OPEN")
-- [실제 사용] 선택된 같은 카드를 다시 눌러 기존 사용 흐름으로 낸다.
local sel
for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("ArtFocused")==true and d.Visible then sel=d end end
assert(sel,"CARD_SELECTED_MISSING_BEFORE_USE")
return string.format("%d,%d CLICK=hand_card_use",math.floor(sel.AbsolutePosition.X+sel.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(sel.AbsolutePosition.Y+sel.AbsoluteSize.Y/2))

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BoardingGui"),"CARD_BOARD_NOT_OPEN")
-- [배치 결과] 내 전장 카드 수가 늘고 손패가 줄어야 실제 사용으로 인정한다(스파이 카드는 상대 전장).
local before=workspace:GetAttribute("QACardBoardBefore") local hb=workspace:GetAttribute("QACardHandBefore")
for i=1,20 do if g:GetAttribute("CardHandMe")~=hb then break end task.wait(0.25) end
local hand=g:GetAttribute("CardHandMe") local board=g:GetAttribute("CardBoardMe")
assert((hand~=nil and hand~=hb) or (board~=nil and board~=before),"CARD_USE_NO_STATE_CHANGE:hand="..tostring(hb).."->"..tostring(hand).." board="..tostring(before).."->"..tostring(board))
-- [화면 겹침] 손패 받침대와 행동 버튼이 화면 밖으로 잘리지 않는지 실측한다.
local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
local tray=g:FindFirstChild("NavalCardHandTray",true)
local cut=0
for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
 if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and not d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame") then
  local p,s=d.AbsolutePosition,d.AbsoluteSize
  if p.X<-1 or p.Y<-1 or p.X+s.X>vp.X+1 or p.Y+s.Y>vp.Y+1 then cut+=1 end
 end
end
-- [터치 크기·겹침 실측] 화면에 보이는 주 버튼의 최소 높이와 손패 받침대·버튼 겹침을 기록한다.
local minH,overlap=999,0
local btns={}
for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
 if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.Parent==g and not d:GetAttribute("HandIdx") then
  local vis=true local x=d while x and x~=g do if x:IsA("GuiObject") and not x.Visible then vis=false end x=x.Parent end
  if vis then table.insert(btns,d) minH=math.min(minH,d.AbsoluteSize.Y) end
 end
end
local function hit(a,b) local p1,s1,p2,s2=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize return p1.X<p2.X+s2.X-1 and p2.X<p1.X+s1.X-1 and p1.Y<p2.Y+s2.Y-1 and p2.Y<p1.Y+s1.Y-1 end
if tray then for _,b in btns do if hit(b,tray) then overlap+=1 end end end
